text:
Typical idea-to-application workflow

Diagram
flowchart LR
    A[Idea or business need] --> B[Clarify users and outcomes]
    B --> C[Define requirements and acceptance criteria]
    C --> D[Design data, interface, and workflow]
    D --> E[Generate or configure application]
    E --> F[Integrate services and data]
    F --> G[Test and validate]
    G --> H[Deploy and monitor]
    H --> I[Collect feedback and improve]
    G -->|Issues found| D

Usually you describe the goal in natural language; the platform or development team turns it into features, screens, data models, business rules, and integrations. A preview is tested against acceptance criteria, corrected, secured, and deployed. Monitoring and user feedback then drive later versions. Because the platform has not been identified, platform-specific automation, approvals, and publishing steps cannot be confirmed.
limitations: The platform is unidentified, so only a general workflow can be described.
